pages.title: The Nest – Family Room – Pu Luong Tree House
pages.text:
The Nest Family Room Pu Luong Tree House
Pu Luong Treehouse is a secluded retreat composed of delightful dwellings. Perched high among tree tops, even higher than the tree houses that have made our fame, is The Nest. This is a traditional wooden house on stilts fitted with artisanal, handmade furniture. The linen beddings, decorative textiles, and lovely artifacts were collected by Zoom during her trips in the north of Viet Nam. The Nest offers stunning views like no others, including of its private pond and garden overflowing with flowers. It is ideal for a family of four, or two couples. A favorite among our habitues, this is one choice to reserve early!

pages.text:
How to Get Here Pu Luong Tree House
Travelling from Hanoi
The shortest way is the 160 km, 4 hour drive from Hanoi, travelling through two provinces, Hoa Binh and Thanh Hoa, with panoramic views of the Pu Luong valley along the way.
Another option is a 4 hour, 180 km drive, which follows the famous Ho Chi Minh Trail and 50 km along the famous Ma River beautiful rice fields.
Travelling from Mai Chau
If you are including Mai Chau in your travels Pu Luong Treehouse is only a 45 km, 1,5 hour drive.
Transport
We can arrange private transports from Hanoi and Ninh Binh to Pu Luong for you.  Please, kindly send us an email for your request via [email protected]
